LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 4.1.1 CONVERSATION SKILLS- NEGOTIATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversation skills- Negotiation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversation skills- Negotiation, part of Strand 4 in Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How can we interrupt another speaker during a conversation? 2. Why is it important to take safety precautions in public places?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording of a conversation between people negotiating over an issue,

2. identify words that the speakers use to interrupt each other,

3. work in partnership with peers to list the words on flashcards,

4. search from online and offline sources for words used to interrupt politely in a conversation,

5. display the words on the language corner for a gallery walk,

6. work collaboratively to conduct a mock group interview on the theme 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording of a conversation between people negotiating over an issue,
2. identify words that the speakers use to interrupt each other,
3. work in partnership with peers to list the words on flashcards,
4. search from online and offline sources for words used to interrupt politely in a conversation,
5. display the words on the language corner for a gallery walk,
6. work collaboratively to conduct a mock group interview on the theme 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversation skills- Negotiation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner uses digital technology to accomplish tasks when searching from online

and offline sources for additional words used to interrupt politely in a conversation.

• Citizenship: It is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively to develop a constructive dialogue when conducting a

mock group interview on the theme using proper turn-taking skills and interrupting politely.

Values:
• Love: It is enhanced as the learner displays trustworthiness when working in partnership with peers to list the words on

flashcards.

• Integrity: This is promoted as the learner exhibits transparency by displaying the words on the language corner for a

gallery walk.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peace Education: This is promoted as the learner interacts with texts and discusses with peers safety in public places as well as

how to negotiate effectively and respectfully in a conversation.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the skills used in negotiation during conversations to the concept of peacebuilding in Social Studies.
